debitMandates.heading: Debit mandates
debitMandates.description: Signed authorizations to collect from this customer's bank account by direct debit. Collections use the most recently signed active mandate that is valid on the collection date.

debitMandates.lockedNote: The bank account, scheme, and reference are fixed once a mandate is recorded.

wages.title: Wage rates
wages.hint: Confidential compensation history. A new rate automatically closes the prior rate the day before it starts.
wages.annualHoursRequired: Enter annual hours greater than zero
wages.saveFailed: Could not update the wage rate
wages.confirmDelete: Delete this wage rate? Previously costed time keeps its saved rate.
wages.roundingEffectiveDateHint: Applies to payroll hours under this dated wage; salary payments and approved job costs are unchanged.
wages.payrollRatePrecisionHelp: Rounds the hourly rate after overtime or other pay multipliers, before hours are priced. It does not change the recorded base rate.
wages.payrollAmountRoundingHelp: Round each time entry before adding, or total matching wage and accounting dimensions before rounding to currency cents.

payComponents.title: Recurring pay components
payComponents.hint: Fixed deductions, taxable benefits and premiums priced every regular run. A component already delivered by a Benefits rule cannot be assigned twice.

payComponents.confirmDelete: Delete this pay-component assignment? Assignments that already priced a stub cannot be deleted.
